titulo: NASA’s Curiosity Rover Catches Stunning Martian Dawn
cuerpo: A newly released panorama captured by NASA’s Curiosity rover offers the most detailed view yet of distant, wind-carved Martian cliffs, highlighting features the mission’s scientists have long been waiting to see up close.
